snippet.title: God of Bath VR – Gameplay Trailer
snippet.description:
Welcome to the official gameplay trailer for God of Bath VR!
A VR action-comedy game based on the hit Korean webtoon The God of Bath.
Experience over-the-top scrub-fighting combat, bathhouse chaos, and a high-energy inspired soundtrack.

🧽 What’s inside the game:

Hand-tracked scrub combat

Hilarious bathhouse battles

Iconic characters from the original webtoon

🔥 Now available in Early Access on Meta Quest.
👉 Meta Store: https://www.meta.com/ko-kr/experiences/god-of-bath/9449936311778609/

More gameplay, updates, and dev insights coming soon.

#GodOfBathVR #VR #MetaQuest #VRgaming #ScrubFighting #세신격투 #목욕의신
